rules: The frozen 18/24 gate may retain confirmatory alpha interpretation only if triplet-level sign independence or another sufficient dependence calibration is justified before interpreting timing results.
Bonferroni across AB and CB does not repair invalid marginal sign-test calibration.
If arbitrary within-cycle dependence cannot be excluded, treat 18/24 counts as descriptive/diagnostic only.

A future distribution-free block-sign confirmatory design at alpha 0.025 requires at least six genuinely independent symmetric blocks for the all-positive event to have p<=0.025; any revised design must be predeclared before observing new timing data.
Do not modify the already frozen 6D3A91 manifest retroactively.
